datasets.name: ASSISTments 2009-2010 skill builder
datasets.licence: Figshare copy (skill_builder_data.csv): CC BY 4.0. The 'corrected' release used when Figshare is unreachable is the same ASSISTments data, distributed for research with citation required by the ASSISTments terms; the GitHub mirror has no licence file of its own.
datasets.citation: Feng, M., Heffernan, N., & Koedinger, K. (2009). Addressing the assessment challenge with an online system that tutors as it assesses. User Modeling and User-Adapted Interaction, 19(3), 243-266.
notes: Cleaning follows Research/dkt/preprocess.py: drop rows with no skill_id; drop duplicate (user_id, order_id, skill_id) rows; multi-skill problems stay one row per skill.
No wall-clock timestamp in this export: order_id is the ordering key, so no time features.
datasets.downloaded_from: GitHub mirror of the official corrected release, skill_builder_data_corrected.csv (LegionKing/Dynamic-Cognitive-Diagnosis @ fbc29da)

datasets.name: ASSISTments 2015 skill builder
datasets.licence: ASSISTments research data, free for research use with citation per the ASSISTments terms. The official Google-Sites/Drive download is blocked from this build environment, so the widely used DKVMN preprocessed copy is used; that mirror repository has no licence file.
datasets.citation: Heffernan, N. T., & Heffernan, C. L. (2014). The ASSISTments ecosystem. International Journal of Artificial Intelligence in Education, 24(4), 470-497. Mirror: Zhang, J., Shi, X., King, I., & Yeung, D.-Y. (2017). Dynamic Key-Value Memory Networks for Knowledge Tracing. WWW.
notes: Mirror format: three lines per student (length, skill ids, answers), 100 skills. The mirror's train and test files are concatenated and re-split by student with this lab's seed.
Original student ids and log ids are not in the mirror: students are numbered in file order, and no time features are available.

datasets.name: Synthetic-5 (Piech et al. 2015)
datasets.licence: No licence file in the repository. Published with the DKT paper as a benchmark; used here for non-commercial research. The raw file is not redistributed (gitignored); only derived aggregates and model weights are committed.
datasets.citation: Piech, C., Bassen, J., Huang, J., Ganguli, S., Sahami, M., Guibas, L., & Sohl-Dickstein, J. (2015). Deep Knowledge Tracing. NeurIPS 28.
notes: SIMULATED: 4,000 virtual students answer the same 50 exercises in the same order; each exercise belongs to one of 5 hidden concepts (IRT-style simulation from the DKT paper).
skill_id = exercise index (0-49). The hidden concept of each exercise is kept as metadata for the explainer only; neither model is given it.

datasets.name: Synaptic simulator (1,000 learners x 60 days)
datasets.source_url: scripts/sim-run.ts in this repository (npm run sim -- --learners 1000 --days 60)
datasets.licence: Generated by this repository's own simulator; same licence as the repository.
notes: SIMULATED learners with a known memory model (src/lib/sim/learner.ts) that forgets over time, practising the real 120-skill Synaptic curriculum under the SM-2 scheduler.
Has simulated timestamps, so it is the one dataset where time features are available.
